about_the_game:
S4bl3 is a grueling, psychological roguelike set in a world of bone, blood, obsidian, and gold. You control a dark wanderer on an excruciating journey through trauma and pain. Quell hellish horrors as you cut your way through increasingly murderous dark entities. But will memory serve you? Or will it leave you second guessing every move?

In S4bl3, death is always watching and waiting, and the world grows more dangerous the further you venture. Each run, a single dark entity will reign and define the challenges you'll face, and other servant entities will grow more powerful with time. Overcome them all, dethrone the reigning entity, and bring your purgatory to its end.

KEY FEATURES

  • Procedural torture dungeons intent on killing you.

  • Lightning-fast, bone-chilling action combat

  • Hordes of unique and hellish denizens

  • Gorgeous visual style inspired by the best retro classics

content_descriptors.notes: S4bl3 contains low-fidelity (pixel art) depictions of violent deaths, including dismemberment, decapitation, and spurting blood. It also includes scary themes, like death, haunting, psychosis, and trauma.
